scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction, from the water customer's seat: ss 45(1)-(2), 47(1)-(3), 48(1), 51(1)-(3), (6), 61(1), (1ZA), (1A), (2)-(3), 63(3)(a), 63A(1), 106(1), (3)-(4), 144(2)-(7), 144A(1)-(3), (5)-(7), 144B(1)-(3) and Schedule 4A of the revised text as at 30 July 2026. Bank holidays in England and Wales are an input. Left out on purpose: the regulators and licensing, resources and requisitions, quality, sewerage beyond s 106, trade effluent, works powers.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass has been run (see INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md); one of its assertions is expected to fail (a late payment and the s 61 power). The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: s 47(3): only conditions imposed within 14 days count; the duty then waits for them.
forks.F2: s 51: relevant day + 13 (pipe laid) or + 20 (21-day presumption).
forks.F3: s 48: whole 50p sums and three-month periods.
forks.F4: s 61(1ZA): power from notice + 8; a later payment does not end it (tester's contrary reading left failing); counter-notice from notice + 1 to + 7.
forks.F5: s 144(7): two working days at day level; informing on an excluded day starts the count at the next working day (after the independent pass).
forks.F6: s 144(4): first relevant day is the earliest event after leaving.
forks.F7: s 144A(5): 12 months beginning with, day before the corresponding date.
